items.summary: Update the backend ritual storage model so ritual entries are stored append-only per coupleId AND per day (e.g., a unique key derived from coupleId + day number), instead of overwriting a single entry per coupleId. Ensure that submitting a ritual response for the same couple on the same day updates the same day’s entry (merging responses by userId), and submitting on a different day creates a new entry without affecting prior days.

Update backend endpoints that currently assume a single ritual entry per couple so they work with the new per-day storage: (1) getRitualStatus must reflect today’s ritual completion status for the couple (based on today’s day key), and (2) getRitualHistory(limit) must return a list of RitualEntryView across multiple days, sorted reliably by date (newest first) and respecting the provided limit argument.

Update the frontend data flow (React Query + any consuming UI) to match the backend’s multi-entry ritual history behavior, ensuring the Home and Memories pages correctly display multiple days and still treat ritualHistory[0] as the latest entry because results are sorted newest-first and limited.
